build_time.description: When the build was made, RFC 3339.

commit.description: The git commit the build is of: quote it with the version when you report a problem.

flavour.description: The build's flavour: release, or local for local mode (ADR-T4).

release.description: The release tag, for the build of a published release only.

version.description: The platform version, set by release-please (REL-02).
